game.title: Back 4 Blood
game.blurb: Co-op zombie first-person shooter played in Acts, from Turtle Rock Studios, released 2021-10-07. RAWG average playtime: 6 hours. Genres: Action, Shooter. Chapters are an estimate drawn from Steam achievement themes.

StrategyWiki: no usable walkthrough, nothing used — https://strategywiki.org/wiki/Back_4_Blood
Fandom (back4blood.fandom.com, CC BY-SA): page names only were checked to confirm structure; no text copied — https://back4blood.fandom.com/wiki/Back_4_Blood
notes: Backlog game, all-AAA pass: picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year across all genres (docs/PLAN.md section 2, genre filter widened 2026-10-23). StrategyWiki has a page at completion stage 1, but only its Cleaners, Controls and Table of Contents subpages are written. The contents page lists Swarm Mode, Achievements and about 33 map pages (from Resurgence to The Abomination), none written, so it was not used and was not added to sw-structure.json. back4blood.fandom.com answers the API with about 54 linked articles, including "Campaign", "Ridden Hives", "Tunnels of Terror", "Swarm", "Trial of the Worm", "Children of the Worm" and "River of Blood"; names only were looked at, nothing copied. The Steam schema calls the app "Gobi" (an internal codename); the store list confirms app 924970 as "Back 4 Blood". None of its 93 achievements is hidden. The Act names in chapter summaries are the ones the achievements name. "Nemesis" (Resurgence) and "Jukebox Hero" (Bar Room Blitz) were put in Act 1 because those maps come early in the StrategyWiki contents order; "Mind Your Step" (The Abomination) was put with Acts 3 and 4 because that map is last in the contents; the secrets in The Nursery, Sunken Passages, The Cut, Brood Lair, 300 Below, Blood Stream and Caustic Cesspool were put with Ridden Hives because they sit right after "Complete All Ridden Hives" on the list; and "Hard-Boiled" (The Harbinger) was put in Act 6 by position. All of these are guesses and need checking. The data does not say which Acts the Fandom pages "Children of the Worm" and "River of Blood" cover.
